tooltip.mover_anchor: The gold mark is the anchor: the icons grow from it the way the arrow points.

messages.bad_index: No buff with that number. Type /sbt list to see the numbers.
messages.list_empty: No buffs tracked. Type /sbt add to add one.
messages.add_usage: Usage: /sbt add <buff> [= spell|item <name, ID or link>]. <buff> is a spell name, ID or link, or mainhand / offhand for a weapon enchant.
messages.unknown_target: A buff must be a spell (name, ID or link) or mainhand / offhand, not an item.
messages.unknown_source_kind: After = type spell or item, then a name, ID or link.
messages.unknown_item: Item not found. Put it in your bags or enter its ID or link (Shift-click it).
messages.in_combat: You can't do that while in combat.

messages.minimap_hidden: Minimap button hidden. Type /sbt minimap to show it again.

add.help: <buff> [= spell|item <source>] - Track a buff. With a source, clicking its icon reapplies it.

remove.help: <number> - Stop tracking a buff (numbers from /sbt list).

mode.help: [all|missing] - Show all buffs with timers, or only the missing ones.

unlock.help: Unlock the panel to move it.

row.help: <count> - Set the number of icons per row.

warn.help: <seconds> - Warn this long before a buff runs out: it glows, and shows up in the missing mode.

minimap.help: Show or hide the minimap button.

config.help: Open or close the panel settings.

buffs.help: Open or close the addon window.

debug.help: Print what the addon sees on your character (for bug reports).

minimap.left_click: Left-click to open the buff window
minimap.right_click: Right-click to lock or unlock the panel
minimap.shift_right_click: Shift-right-click to toggle the display mode
minimap.no_library: LibDBIcon not found. The minimap button is disabled.
minimap.shift_click: Shift-click to open the panel settings

settings.locked_hint: Unlocked: a green overlay covers the panel. Drag it to move, right-click it to lock. Locked: Shift-drag the panel to move it. Not available in combat.
settings.no_buff_chosen: Add a buff or select one on the left.
settings.aura_note: Spell name or ID. Suggests your spells and any buff you have had. Drag a spell here or Shift-click it.
settings.spell_note: Drag a spell here from your spellbook, or Shift-click it while this field is active.
settings.item_note: Drag an item here from your bags, or Shift-click it while this field is active.
settings.icon_note: Leave empty to use the buff's own icon. Suggests your spells, bag items and buffs you have had. Drag or Shift-click also works.
settings.add_note: Drag buffs to reorder them. Shift-click one of your buffs (top right of the screen) to add it.
settings.enchant_note: Enchants seen on your weapons. Not listed? Apply it once (oil, Flametongue...).
settings.conditions_hint: All the conditions you set must be met. A hidden buff is not on the panel in any display mode.
settings.condition_places_note: Uncheck the places where this buff is not needed.
settings.condition_item_note: Shown only while this item is in your bags (food, oil, flask...). Leave empty to skip. Drag an item here or Shift-click it.
settings.condition_talent_note: Shown only if you have learned it, such as a talent of your specialization. Leave empty to skip. Suggests talents and spells.
settings.status_shown: Right now: shown on the panel
settings.hidden_not_set_up: Not set up yet: enter the buff on the right.
settings.condition_places_nowhere: Everything unchecked: this buff is never shown.

about.description:
Keeps an eye on your buffs: the ones you care about sit on one small panel of icons that look like action bar buttons. Show them all with their timers, or only the missing ones and the ones about to run out.

Give a buff a source and a left-click on its icon puts it back: casts the spell, eats the food for Well Fed, drinks the elixir or applies the oil to your weapon.
about.hint: Also: left-click the minimap button, type /sbt buffs, or right-click a buff on the panel.
